scripts.scope: Literal source-derived spatial interaction episode; intended legal actions, not executed or seed-searched.
scripts.intended_objective: Give fuel, broadcast an untrusted north-route claim, converge into a convoy, pledge and perform alternating escorts, then move each vehicle to its own destination and attempt delivery.
notes: The north claim is scripted without reading the seed outcome and may be audited false.
Vehicles protect both crossing phases so the action plan does not require choosing the sampled safe lane.
Delivery and promise-history outcomes remain unexecuted hypotheses; harmless-route guard does not count as a fulfilled dangerous-passage promise.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Same seed and prefix, exactly one changed agent action, identical remaining suffix.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: A single scout guard action should protect both entering carriers if north is dangerous; if north is safe the peer-damage contrast is zero. Guard fuel/reward cost exists in either case. Seed outcome is unknown.

legal_action_status: Source-reasoned only; no runtime mask or trajectory has been evaluated.
replay_requirements: Replay actual reset/raw_step states with trusted key splitting. Stop on done_all. Preserve failures or illegal scripted actions as evidence; do not edit this script to fit a result.
